events.title: Flap overspeed
events.description: IAS above the VFE for the flap angle, which comes from the aircraft's type profile (profiles/<ICAO>.yaml, manufacturer's airspeed limitations). Silent without a profile. Levels above VFE are a FOQA-Sim estimate.
events.why_it_matters: Exceeding VFE stresses the flap structure and its attachments beyond what they were certified for; it can damage the flaps and requires a maintenance inspection.
events.advice: Reduce speed below VFE (the top of the white arc) before extending the flaps, and retract them before accelerating beyond it.

events.title: High descent rate below 500 ft (light aircraft)
events.description: Descent rate from 500 ft to the flare, held 5 s. FSF ALAR stabilised approach: no more than 1000 fpm; the levels 1200 / 1500 / 2000 fpm are a FOQA-Sim estimate.
events.why_it_matters: A steep, fast final leaves little height to arrest the sink: a common precursor of hard and short landings.
events.advice: Fly a stable path of about 3 degrees (roughly 500-700 fpm in a light aircraft); more than 1000 fpm on short final: go around.

events.title: High descent rate at 500 ft
events.description: Rate of descent at the 500 ft gate against the FSF ALAR stabilised approach limit, 1000 fpm. An advisory: the descent below 500 ft is graded by `high-sink-below-500` and `high-sink-light`.
events.why_it_matters: A steep, fast descent at 500 ft leaves little height to arrest the sink, a common precursor of hard and short landings.
events.advice: Fly a stable path of about 3 degrees (roughly 500-700 fpm in a light aircraft, 700-800 fpm in a jet). More than 1000 fpm at the gate: go around.
